test_inference_dropout_retained: test that retain_dropout=True sets apply_during_inference on encoder and decoder dropout modules
test_inference_dropout_default_false: test that dropout is disabled during inference by default when retain_dropout is not set
test_training_mode_toggle: test that calling eval() on the model disables training mode on all dropout modules
test_retain_dropout_modules_filter: test that retain_dropout_modules list selectively retains dropout only on specified module types
build_transformer_model_with_dropout: build a TransformerModel with retain_dropout enabled and prepare it for inference using OmegaConf
